mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the industrial production index exceeding 3% signals supply chain contraction, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below -4% combined with a 6-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below -10% signals a deep demand contraction, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth < -4% AND HOUST YoY growth < -10% over 6 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the unemployment rate above 4.5% combined with a 3-month decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% AND PAYEMS YoY growth < -1% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the industrial production index exceeding 3% combined with a 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below -2% signals a deep supply-demand shock, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth < -3% AND RSAFS YoY growth < -2% over 6 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.
